translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Elleelli hananaw bessiyaawaa bare oosanchchatuwaa bessana mala, S'oossay Yesuusi Kiristtoosaw immeedda sas'ay hawaa; Yesuusi bare kiitanchchaa kiittiide, ha sas'aa bare oosanchchaa Yohaannisa erisseedda.
Yohaannisi be"iide tumatetsaan odeedda ubbabay, S'oossaa k'aalaanne Yesuusi Kiristtoosa markkatetsaa.
Ha mas'aafaa nabbabiyaa uray
anjjetteeddawaa; k'ay ha timbbitiyaa mas'aafaa sisiyaawanttunne ha mas'aafan s'aafetteeddawaa naagiyaawanttu anjjetteeddawantta; ayaw gooppe, ha yewuu polettanaw wodii matatteedda.
Iisiyaan De'iyaa Laappu Woosa Golletoo Kiitetteedda Sarotaa

content.text: K'ay Aa kawutetsaa oydiyaa sintsan de'iyaa laappu ayyaanatuwaappe,
Nuuna bare S'oossawunne Aawoo ootsana mala,

content: Kase de'iyaawe, ha"ikka de'iyaawe, sintsappekka yaana Goday, Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama S'oossay, «Ubbabaw Alfaynne Omeegay, koyruunne wurssetsay Taana»
yaagee.
Kiristtoosi Sas'aan K'onc'c'eeddawaa

Taani Yohaannisi, hinttenttu ishay, hinttenana Yesuusi Kiristtoosa waayiyaanne Aa kawutetsaa k'ay Aa danddayaa ittippe shaakettiyaawe, S'oossaa k'aalaa odeedda dirawunne Yesuusawaa markkatteedda diraw, Piis'imo giyaa haatsay dooddo biittaan de'aaddi.
Godaa gallassan taani Ayyaanan de'ay; taani taappe guyyenna malakataa waasuwaa mala wolk'k'aama kooshshaa sisaad.

He kooshshay taana, «Neeni be'iyaawaa mas'aafan s'aafa; Iisiyaan de'iyaa laappu woosa golletoo, Efesoona, Samirineesa, P'erggaamoona, Tiyaas'iroona, Sarddeesa, Pilaadelifiyaa, Lodook'iyaa woosa golletoo yeedda» yaageedda.
Taani taw odiyaa kooshshaa be'anaw guyye simmaaddi; s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa laappu work'k'aa ballatuwaa be'aaddi.
He ballatuwaa giddon Asaa Na'aa malatiyaawaa be'aaddi; adussa afilaa bare gediyaa gatsi mayyiide, work'k'aa danc'c'uwaa bare tiraan yuushshi aatseedda.
Aa huup'iinne Aa huup'iyaa binnaanay bootsa dorssaa isikiyaanne hewaappekka aad'd'iide shachchaa malatee; Aa ayfiikka tamaa lac'uwaa malatee.
Aa gediikka c'ooc'iyaa tamaan teeriide p'ooliyaa nahaasiyaa giyaa birataa malatee; Aa kooshshaykka wolk'k'aama shaafaa guntsaa mala.
I bare ushechcha kushiyan laappu s'oolinttatuwaa oyk'k'eedda. Aa doonaappe laa"u baggana k'aaretteedda mashshay keseedda. Aa deemuukka loytsi poo'iyaa awayfiyaa malatee.
Taani Aa be'eedda wode hayk'k'eeddawaadan hanaade, Aa gediyaa matan kunddaad. Bare ushechcha kushiyaa ta bolla wotsiide, taana hawaadan yaageedda; «Yayyoppa; koyruukka wurssetsaykka taana.
Taani de'uwaan de'iyaawaa. Taani hayk'k'aaddi; shin be'a, med'i med'inawukka de'uwaan de'ay. Hayk'uwaa k'ulppiinne Si'ooliyaa k'ulppii ta kushiyan de'ee.
Simmi neeni be'eeddabaanne ha"i de'iyaawaa, k'ay sintsappe hananabaa s'aafa.

Neeni ta ushechcha kushiyan be'eedda laappu s'oolinttatuwaa biletsaynne k'ay s'omppatuwaa wotsiyaa laappu work'k'aa ballatuwaa biletsay hawaa; laappu s'oolinttatuu laappu Woosa Golletuwaa kiitanchchatuwaa;
woosa golliyaa laappu work'k'aa ballatuu laappu woosa golliyaa.»

footnotes.text: Nabbabiyaa uray: Hawaa guussay ubbaa Asay ittippe S'oossaa goshetiyaa woden hewanttoo k'aalaa nabbabiyaa uray anjjetteeddawaa guussaa.
Iisiyaa gadiyaa: 1:4—3:22De'iyaawe dabddaabbiyaa gidiide s'aafetteedda. Iisiyaa gadii awayifii doliyaa baggana de'iyaa Roome kawutetsaa gidiide ha"i ha wodiyaan Turike gadiyaa giide s'eesettiyaawaa.

Alfaynne Omeegay: Hawaa guussay Ooratsa C'aak'uu koyro Giriike K'aalaan s'aafetteedda diraw, koyruunne wurssetsay gaanaw koyyiide, Alfaa giyaa Giriike koyro pidoliyaa akkiide wurssetsaw k'ay Omeegaa giyaa wurssetsaan de'iyaa pidoliyaa akkeeddino. Hawantta guussay leemisuwaan Dawurootsuwaa pidolatuwaa akkintto [A, Z] yaagiyaawaa mala guussa.
Kiitanchchatuwaa: Hawantta guussay ammaniyaawantta kaaletsiyaa c'imatuwaa woy ammaniyaawanttoo kiitetteeddawantta.
